messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — P1 metering emission lag (possible token recount). See: https://redwood.in/incident/7182345678. Triggered 2026-03-17T02:14:38Z

Sasha: acked. I'm on it. Initial triage: emitter ingestion consumer (us-west) lagging. Delayed usage reports ~35-70m. A handful of customers getting transient overage flags.

Jamal: grabbing kafka offsets from emitter-ingest consumer group now. Seeing ~210k msg gap on partition 17. looks like a retry-burst.

Leah: are CS alerts firing? which customers flagged? @cs-alerts-bot please confirm noisy emails. :loud_sound:

Sasha: quick log excerpt from emitter around the window:
```
2026-03-17T01:40:12Z WARN emitter: write_timeout for shard-17
2026-03-17T01:40:13Z INFO emitter: retrying batch id=XX-abc count=1024
2026-03-17T01:41:05Z ERROR emitter: downstream 503, backoff
```

Mike: taking oncall. Sasha handing off now — will run recount and suppress noisy alerts. ETA ~25m.

Sasha: two immediate mitigations: 1) pause automatic overage emails for affected accounts; 2) kick a recount/backfill over the gap window.

ops-tooling: Started job -> `start_recount --from 2026-03-17T01:00Z --to 2026-03-17T02:20Z --priority=high` -> job_id=rc-7182345678
Command run: 
``
$ ./ops/recount --job rc-7182345678 --apply
``

Jamal: consumer offsets are catching up. We're seeing a burst of late emissions replay into the ingestion pipeline. Expect counts to spike as backfill applies.

Mike: muting overage notifications for now for the most noisy accounts: acct-112 acct-478 acct-999. Notifying CS to hold manual outreach until we reconcile.

cs-alerts-bot: Muted notifications for accounts: acct-112, acct-478, acct-999 until 2026-03-17T04:00Z

Sasha: recount job is running; monitoring shadow-ledger vs live counts. If job succeeds we'll run reconcile and publish corrected usage.

Leah: impact summary for ops notes: ~12 accounts saw immediate overage flags; most are transient and will be corrected post-recount. CS to prepare templated message.

Mike: confirmed active incident. Will hold handoff notes and pass to Eng-Night at handoff. Postmortem required — tag as P1-metering-recount. :white_check_mark:

Sasha: leaving notes in the incident doc + links to job logs. If anyone sees new customer-facing alerts, ping here.
